result.reason: The redline appropriately reaches the 90-day fallback for Deliverable conformity and preserves a remedy for timely reported nonconformities, assuming Section 19.4 provides repair, replacement, or refund. However, it does not include the required professional and workmanlike services warranty, the 30-day fallback services period, compliance with laws, or the no-malicious-code warranty. It therefore addresses only part of the playbook position. The changes made are narrow and professionally drafted without disturbing unrelated commercial terms.
